stages.label: Triage
stages.note: Cheap first look: which lane is this, and is a human really on camera. · his engine: gemini-video · his display id: 0

stages.label: Teardown
stages.note: One video in, one objective record out — scenes, mechanics, psychology. · his engine: gemini-video · his display id: 1

stages.label: Audience
stages.note: Which avatar, which funnel, which topics — decided after the breakdown, because a video has to be torn down before anyone can say who it speaks to. · his engine: claude · his display id: 1b

stages.label: Spec
stages.note: The record, abstracted into a brand-free construct everything else slots into. · his engine: gemini-text · his display id: 2

stages.label: Injection
stages.note: Substitution, never rewrite — the source transcript is the template. · his engine: claude · his display id: 3

stages.label: Reading
stages.note: What the source already is: its lane, its opening beat, the awareness it enters on. Decides nothing about our version. · his engine: claude · his display id: 4a

stages.label: Hooks
stages.note: A control plus five variations. All ship to test — the machine never picks. · his engine: claude · his display id: 4b

stages.label: Placement
stages.note: Where the product enters and the runtime budget — decided after the hooks exist, so it places against the real opening. · his engine: claude · his display id: 4c

stages.label: Expansion
stages.note: Gated moves — each names the baseline line it serves or stays out. · his engine: claude · his display id: 4d

stages.label: Close
stages.note: The objection at the flinch, then the guarantee-led close. · his engine: claude · his display id: 4e

stages.label: Audit
stages.note: Seven checks against the source. It reports; it gates nothing. · his engine: claude · his display id: 4f

stages.label: Brief
stages.note: The product — the one document the maker receives. · his engine: claude · his display id: 5

stages.label: Frames
stages.note: A reference picture on every scene: her own video first, generated only for what her reel does not contain, and never a stand-in. · his engine: frames · his display id: 6
